authority.phase40_frozen_failure: The failed direct-Doppler candidate remains historical evidence; its physical gates, thresholds, and source are not changed by this audit.

objective.question: Does the raw Android Doppler measurement preserve its physical unit and sign through the adapter and known-satellite terms into both the independent SPP velocity equation and FGO Doppler factor fields?
objective.allowed_result: diagnosis-no-go unless one concrete measurement-contract bug is proven by code and numerical identity evidence

mtv_h_first_probe.first_solvable_definition: The first epoch in raw UTC order with at least four rows accepted by the unchanged adapter/FGO satellite-state construction and finite independent equation inputs.

known_satellite_terms: broadcast satellite clock drift (s/s and m/s after c multiplication)
earth-rotation/Sagnac correction and its velocity term
measurement_contract.los_definition: LOS is the unit vector used by the existing satellite-state/range-rate model, with its documented receiver-to-satellite orientation recorded explicitly.
measurement_contract.independent_spp_identity: measured_range_rate_mps = LOS dot (satellite_velocity_ecef - receiver_velocity_ecef) - satellite_clock_drift_mps + earth_rotation_term + receiver_clock_rate_mps, with exact signs/terms taken from the independently written audit equation and compared numerically rather than assumed.
measurement_contract.fgo_identity: FGO Doppler factor measured_range_rate_mps, modeled_range_rate_mps, satellite_clock_drift_mps, wavelength_m, and residual_mps must be compared field-by-field against the same row and seed.
measurement_contract.comparison_scope: Every row at the same first solvable MTV-h epoch; no row may be dropped without a recorded reason and row-selection comparison.

correction_allowed_only_if: a concrete contract bug is located in source code
the bug is demonstrated by numerical identity/unit/sign mismatch on frozen raw inputs
a separate explicit opt-in flag is used
production default and Phase31 champion remain byte-identical
source and focused tests are committed and pushed before the six-route structure run
correction_forbidden_if: evidence is only an implausible velocity or clock rate
the proposed action is a sign flip without identity proof
the proposed action is a threshold relaxation
the mismatch is unresolved or only inferred from a route-level result

execution_order: commit and push this freeze JSON
implement truth-free audit and focused tests, then commit and push
run MTV-h target audit and record every first-solvable-epoch row
compare SPP velocity and FGO WLS on the same epoch/seed and record row-selection differences
if and only if a contract bug is proven, implement separately flagged opt-in correction and focused tests
run MTV-h plus the other five frozen raw routes for structure
run relevant CTest and verify flag-off/default identity
publish an immutable v1 result; any supplement uses a new v2 file
forbidden_actions: use precomputed result/submission coordinates for inference
use truth, validation, holdout, Kaggle, or tokens
fit or apply a truth/common constant/body-frame correction
change production defaults or Phase31 champion path
rewrite this freeze after the audit
decision_rule: A contract correction is Go only when source code and frozen-raw numerical identities prove one concrete unit/sign/known-satellite-term defect. Otherwise diagnosis is No-Go and the next measurement is specified without changing thresholds, signs, defaults, or the frozen Phase40 failure.
